title: Counterpoint: laptop mini-LED shipments to drop 75% within two years, as OLED takes over the premium laptop market
summary: According to new estimates from Counterpoint Research (DSCS), global shipments of mini-LED panels for laptops will decrease by 38% in 2026, and by a further 60% in 2027 - so 2027 shipments will reach only about 25% of their 2025 level. Laptop OLED panel shipments, on the other hand, are projected to grow by 50% in 2026 and by another 24% in 2027, while the overall laptop display market is expected to shrink by 3% this year.
